Proposition
[estimates for Busemann approximants]

Source: petersen:page-0316 ↗ def:pet-ch7-ray-line ↗ lem:pet-ch7-laplacian-comparison-calabi 1. ch7:7.3.6The functions $b_t$, $t\ge 0$, satisfy:

  1. for fixed $x$, $t\mapsto b_t(x)$ is decreasing and bounded in absolute value by $|xc(0)|$;

  2. $|b_t(x)-b_t(y)|\le |xy|$;

  3. $\Delta b_t(x)\le \dfrac {n-1}{b_t(x)+t}$ everywhere.

Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch7-busemann-approximants \sketch The triangle inequality gives $|b_t(x)|\le |xc(0)|$, monotonicity in $t$, and the Lipschitz bound. Since $b_t+t$ is a distance function based at $c(t)$, subsection 1.4 gives $\Delta b_t\le (n-1)/(b_t+t)$.

□
